# Social Media, Algorithms, and Artificial Intelligence Claim Audit

**Lesson:** T4-L22 - Social Media, Algorithms, and Artificial Intelligence

**Read:** Psalm 101:1-4; Philippians 4:8-9; James 3:1-12

## Observe
- Record two direct observations from the passage.
- Identify relevant context and genre.

## Reason
- Test this big idea: Digital systems shape attention, speech, desire, power, and neighbour-love and therefore require moral discernment.
- Label what is explicit text, synthesis/inference, framework position, or prudential application.

## Respond
- Name one faithful response that does not claim more than the evidence supports.

## Guardrail
- Treat AI and algorithms as tools and systems that can amplify both good and harm; avoid technological panic or hype.
purpose: Support the Social Media, Algorithms, and Artificial Intelligence lesson with an evidence-based claim audit.
title: Social Media, Algorithms, and Artificial Intelligence Claim Audit
